changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'CompanyResourceTheme') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[CompanyResourceTheme]( [CompanyID] [int] NOT NULL, ResourceID int not null, ThemeID int not null, CONSTRAINT [PK_ResourceTheme] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( CompanyID, ResourceID ASC ) ) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'CompanyResourceTheme') BEGIN drop table dbo.CompanyResourceTheme END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [sys].[foreign_keys] WHERE name = 'FK_CompanyResourceTheme_Theme') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CompanyResourceTheme] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_CompanyResourceTheme_Theme] FOREIGN KEY(CompanyID,[ThemeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[CompanyTheme] (CompanyID,[ID]) on delete cascade ALTER TABLE [dbo].[CompanyResourceTheme] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_CompanyResourceTheme_Theme] END
